messages:
riley: opened a quick thread for the Lumen dark theme PR. goals: tighten chart contrast, make code tokens easier to scan, and propose a colorblind-safe categorical palette. screenshots in the PR.

tasha: pulled the images. nice direction. immediate nit: metric axis labels at 12px fail contrast on the panel bg. bump to 14px or use --text-primary.

ngo: code block note: keywords and functions are too close. suggestion: keyword #c9a8ff, string #ffb76a, func/ident #7fc3ff. warmer strings help scanning.

finn: charts: avoid red/green pairs. proposed categorical set for dark surfaces: #86d3be, #bfa7e6, #ffad7a, #7fb8ff, #ffd36a. colorblind-friendly and pops on deep panels.

marie: heatmap should be sequential single-hue (amber -> deep-amber) rather than diverging. easier to read in CVD sims. also add a subtle 1px separator on OLED to keep structure.

riley: small CSS vars i'm testing:
```css
:root{
  --bg-900:#050608;
  --panel-800:#0c0f11;
  --text-primary:#e8eef6;
  --muted:#98a4aa;
  --accent:#7fb2ff;
}
```

tasha: focus outline on icon buttons is low-visibility. recommend 3px ring with an alpha'd accent (less glare).

ngo: for legend overflow on small cards, switch to a horizontal scroll with a left/right fade instead of wrapping. prevents title collisions.

finn: micro-interaction: on hover for thin lines add a subtle halo instead of thickening stroke. `filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.6));` keeps default clean.

marie: copy suggestion: in Settings rename "Enable dark mode" -> "Theme: Light / Dark / OLED". clearer and consistent. add tooltip: "OLED uses true-black for supported displays."

riley: will update PR: bump axis labels, swap heatmap to amber ramp, adopt the proposed categorical palette, adjust syntax tokens, increase focus ring, add horizontal legend overflow behavior, and change toggle copy. adding accessibility checklist to PR desc.

design-bot: PR #2301 created by riley (branch/lumen-theme). visual-diff report pending: 4 images added. CI: visual tests queued -> https://ci.internal/reports/2301

tasha: i'll run contrast checks once visuals land. ping @tasha for sims. :mag:

ngo: small follow-up: can we add a stylelint rule to prevent raw hexes in components and require semantic tokens? prevents drift between themes.

finn: looks good overall, thanks for the rapid iteration :thumbsup:

riley: thanks all — merging once visuals are green.
